title: SvgFeImage
responsibility: Renders the native feImage element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeImage.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the feImage element when truthy. When omitted, it produces no rendered child content.

outputs.name: SvgFeImage
outputs.description: The component renders a native SVG feImage element with the remaining props spread onto it and the optional snippet rendered inside. It adds no wrapper or extra behavior.
